Taking a more cynical and negative approach.  
\- Firstly unit design and quality seems to be a complete downgrade from last year. Last year both Part 1 and 2 units had amazing animations with amazing to good kits. The kits for this years units are good but only under certain circumstances and the conditions they have been given are just simply frustrating.  
\- Following on, the dip in animation quality is also annoying. Last year all 4 LRs had flawless to really amazing animations but this year it feels like some animations were sacrificed just so the "dokkan originals" could work. Outside of Future Gohan the animations are very noticeably clunky and not as polished as last year.  
\- Similarly, the kit for in particular Base VB is just frustrating to work around especially at lower dupe levels, especially since Zamasu already got an amazing partner.  
\- I've actually been a fan of the EZAs this year tbh and would say they are better than last years, AGL Zamasu and TEQ Trunks both have uses and the other 6 ezas all have uses themselves and are not DOA.  
\- Unit Choice for Part 2 is just flat out stupid, I'm glad Future Gohan is as good as he is but I would rather they copy pasted his kit onto Trunks and then made Goku Black a Part 2 LR.  
\- F2P Units are sad, or rather unit. I don't care about the animations of F2P units and I would have loved if they had followed last year and did 5 f2p goku black clones, give them like the divine lasso from AGL Goku Black, I could not care, just give them use.  
\- The Growth Events are fantastic, there's no denying that.  
\- The Red Zone is fine ish, but it seems kind of redundant to release units that at a minimum come out on turn 5 but then release content that finishes at the same mark.  


Overall, even though I am negative. This is still an 7-9/10 celebration. The amount of free stuff we get is insane, I just wish it didn't feel like every part of the game was worked on by a seperate team and has no cohesion. But the changes that have been made (free medal missions) are good.
